explanation: Faithfully states Tang's suggestion on erdosproblems.com/1044. For each fixed degree n ≥ 1, Λ(z^n - 1) is the least value of Λ over admissible f of degree n, which means the infimum is attained by z^n - 1. The polynomial z^n - 1 has its roots on the unit circle, so it is itself admissible.
